lines.text: @sai_front rolls a stripe of bright blue paint across a white wall, steps back, and tilts his head.
Locked off; he walks out of frame.

new_beats.text: One stripe, and it already feels like home.

writes.note: I kept the shot as it is and added a short VO line over the first stripe.

reply.rationale: The shot's words stay; one brief VO beat early in the shot fits the 15 s spot without crowding the action.
